name: Sidebar Full-Width Toggle
author: Steve North

sections.description:
Adds a button to the Gutenberg block sidebar (right) to toggle the editor sidebar to make it full-width. This plugin also allows dragging the sidebar left and right to provide a custom width.

Particularly useful if you need more space to work with the additional block options or you use ACF to populate block options.

This plugin is seamlessly integrated to look like it’s a native option to the Gutenberg interface.

In addition:

  • NO ads.
  • NO annoying notices/popups.
  • NO code bloat.
  • NO pro/paid version. (It is and always will be FREE).
sections.changelog:

1.1.1
